blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – A total of 235 employees of the Municipality of Catmon tested negative for illegal drugs during a surprise drug screening conducted on Thursday, November 19, at the town’s covered court. Leading by example, Mayor Avis Ginoo-Monleon was the first to undergo the drug test, demonstrating the local government’s commitment to maintaining a drug-free workplace. Mayor Avis said the initiative aims to ensure that municipal employees remain free from illegal drug use, emphasizing that public servants must uphold discipline, responsibility, and integrity to maintain public trust.
